scope.purpose: measure frequent scalar and compressed instruction costs
scope.selection: dynamic gap frequency; no candidate outcome threshold
scope.scope: CPU 0; fixed operands; dependent chain and four independent streams
scope.output_checks: every scalar accumulator, counter and guards; all samples retained
scope.intervals: measurement ranges; not algorithm prediction confidence

prediction_validation.scope: parameter measurements alone do not prove unseen-kernel accuracy

limits: stream cost includes finite independent-chain limits
vector memory latency is not isolated
no multicore bandwidth or coherence model
measurement ranges are not prediction confidence intervals
